compensation.variable_compensation_linked_to: Performance against targets, capital guidance and ambitions

risks.description: Material weakness in internal control over financial reporting identified as of 31 December 2024 due to increased complexity of internal accounting and control environment post-Credit Suisse merger
risks.mitigation: Management working on remediation; additional evidence of effective operation of remediated controls required

risks.description: Execution risk related to Credit Suisse integration including client account migrations and platform decommissioning
risks.mitigation: On track to substantially complete integration by end-2026; major legal entity mergers completed in 2024; >90% of client assets outside Switzerland migrated to UBS platforms

risks.description: Swiss capital requirements changes including potential full deduction of foreign subsidiary investments from CET1 capital, requiring around USD 22bn incremental capital at UBS AG standalone level
risks.mitigation: Constructive dialogue with regulators; maintaining strong capital position (CET1 ratio 14.3% at end-2024)

risks.description: Volatile and unpredictable geopolitical and market environment affecting client sentiment and activity levels
risks.mitigation: Diversified global business model; balance sheet for all seasons; focus on client service and risk management

risks.description: Swiss Federal Council amendments to Capital Adequacy Ordinance: capitalized software subject to max 3-year amortization (effective 2029); revised prudential valuation adjustments (effective 2027); estimated net CET1 capital impact of approximately USD 2bn at UBS AG standalone when fully implemented
risks.mitigation: Phase-in periods provide time to adjust; maintaining strong capital ratios

risks.description: Operational failures including fraud, misconduct, cyberattacks, data leakage and systems failures; risk increased with persistently high levels of cyberattack threats
risks.mitigation: Robust infrastructure with >99.999% availability; high security standards; 70% of infrastructure in public/private Cloud

risks.description: Liability exposure from litigation including inherited Credit Suisse litigation; potential for large fines, disqualification from businesses, loss of licenses
risks.mitigation: Active risk management and legal governance; provisions recorded in connection with Credit Suisse acquisition

evidence: Deployment of 50,000 Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses in Q4 2024, largest in global financial services at the time
Rollout of 'Red' internal chatbot using generative AI to around 30,000 employees
Over 500 live AI use cases across the bank with around 750 in development as of Q1 2026
9 large-scale end-to-end transformational AI initiatives in progress as of Q1 2026
13 million AI-generated insights delivered to US advisors in 2024
1.75 million prompts across all AI tools in 2024
UBS named Best Wealth Management Firm for Use of AI in US by Financial Times PWM Wealth Tech Awards
Strategic approach to AI through Smart Technologies and Advanced Analytics Team (STAAT)
Partnerships with leading academic institutions for AI research
AI integration in Direct Investment Insights function and UBS Advice Compass
ai_positioning.summary_fr: UBS se positionne comme leader dans l'adoption de l'IA dans le secteur financier mondial. Avec le plus grand déploiement de licences Microsoft Copilot (50'000) dans les services financiers, plus de 500 cas d'usage actifs et 9 initiatives transformationnelles majeures, UBS utilise l'IA pour améliorer l'expérience client, augmenter la productivité des employés et renforcer ses capacités analytiques. La firme a développé des solutions propriétaires comme 'Red' (chatbot interne) et a livré 13 millions d'insights générés par IA aux conseillers américains en 2024. Cette approche stratégique a été reconnue par le Financial Times qui a nommé UBS 'Best Wealth Management Firm for Use of AI in the US'.
